notes.title: Before the sequel!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi good people![/h1]

[h2]I have no time to read![/h2]

Warcat Parade won't be updated. However, there will be a sequel! I failed the communication. For the second game, I plan to communicate during the production and not afterwards.
Price of the game has been lowered to 5.99 catnips - from 9.99 catnips.
I have ten Steam keys to distribuate, I think about a way to distribute them.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Warcat Parade has been developed with Unity Engine. The development started in 2021. In the meantime, a lot of bad buzzes lowered the reputation of Unity and Warcat Parade has almost been aborted. As a consequence, the sequel will be developed with Godot Engine, even if it implies I will need to learn to use a new game engine.

As mentioned before, I really failed the communication for Warcat Parade 1. I developed the game while I had harsh personal issues so the production has been made on high voltage. Also, I have to admit, I was really stuck in the past. Nowadays, you can't develop a game alone in your basement, release in on Steam and wait for the feedbacks!

So, what will happen for Warcat Parade 2? I plan to communicate during the production process and not too late, on collaborative platforms. The only bad point is: I am a developer and I have almost no skill in communication - you know the cliché huh, I was the kid in school who had no friends. Wish me luck!

That will mean the future community, - that means you -, will be surely be a part of the production so I will take the correct decisions! More info coming soon, but I am already preparing stuff for Warcat Parade 2 and that will be a bullet hell as... Hell.

[i]Hefka[/i]

notes.title: Warcat Parade is available!
notes.content:
[h2]Game is released![/h2]

How it will evolve.

Nyan nyan, pew pew pew! Hello you little nekopunks!

I am stressed and I am over anxious. I worked like a madman on this game and I made it all alone, so I don't even know if the game is good or bad. I'm stressed. I hope you'll like it!

[h2]How the game will evolve?[/h2]

First things first, I wonder if the game is maybe not too difficult. I mean, come on, this is a bullet hell, it's meant to be hardcore. But after the last tests before release, no wonder I went really too far.

Therefore, this is highly probable I'll post an update soon with a massive rehaul of difficulty, especially in level 1, and that I mahe the "White cat" playstyle slightly stronger.

About me. This game has been made with Unity and the project has started in 2021. This engine generated a severe bad buzz in September 2023. So if I develop a sequel, I can tell it will be developed in Godot Engine.

Along the planned updates, I also plan to remake the hiscores panel in game, so the "normal difficulty" scores are not mixed with the harder ones.

Also, I plan to make a major update with a new feature : bonuses and maluses, to make the game easier or harder and alter the score, for the most hardcore of you who want the hi-score ! :D

[i]Hefka[/i]

notes.title: Awesome! Warcat Parade is ready for publication!
notes.content:
[h1]Nyan, nyan, pew pew pew![/h1]

Hi, dear nekomata ! I have an awesome new for you!
The bug I discovered - [i]Well, more like the bug that has been reported by Steam... [/i]- was critical but not that hard to fix! That means it has already been fixed! Therefore, I'm pleased to announce [b]the game is officially ready for public release, nyaa![/b]

That means the game has been delayed once, but [u]it won't be delayed twice![/u]

[h3]How do i feel?[/h3]

To be honest, I don't really know how I am supposed to feel. This is the first time I am publishing a game on Steam. I already made some games and published them on itch but it was mostly short game for jams. I worked like a madman on Warcat Parade, so much so much. I don't even know if my game is good or not now... I am aware the game have a high difficulty and I can't stop thinking maybe I did it wrong for ages.

I am over-stressed but at least this is done now! Release date: September 1st! Theoriginal soundtrack will be released September 30th, by the way >_< Nyan!

[h3]Nyan nyan, pew pew pew![/h3]

[i]Hefka[/i]
